text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
What a fine morning. One might say it's 
prime weather for experimenting!
choice_data_list: Looks like you got some good rest.
Looks like you got some good rest.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you. As long as one is alive, 
one realizes that all living things need 
rest.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Now then, shall we cheerfully begin 
today's experiment? In search of the 
glorious possibilities of bodily 
remodeling, of course.

Agnes Tachyon is in good spirits. It seems 
she got plenty of proper rest.
